_notes: Team name: EN 'Hangyul team' -> 'Hangyul-ийн баг', EN 'Hangyul Univ team' -> 'Hangyul Univ-ийн баг'; every 'зөвлөх тань' (counselor) in Student/mobile copy replaced with the team, since the English names the team and the glossary avoids 'advising'.
'Matches' rendered as 'тохирох хөтөлбөрүүд' (programs that fit you) everywhere; bare 'тохирол' is not natural Mongolian.
Plan stays 'багц' (established across the file); 'upgrade' rendered as 'дээд багц руу шилжих', never 'шинэчлэх' (= renew/update).

One term per concept: managed application = 'тантай хамт хөтлөх өргөдөл'; mock interview = 'дадлагын ярилцлага'; university recommendation = 'санал болгох их сургуулиуд'; personal statement + study plan = 'өөрийн танилцуулга, суралцах төлөвлөгөө'; follow-up consultation = 'дараагийн зөвлөгөө'; visa document preparation = 'визийн бичиг баримтын бэлтгэл'; arrival & settling-in = 'ирэх, суурьших'.
student:v15.services.scope.personal_roadmap: avoided 'суралцах төлөвлөгөө' (reserved for the 학업계획서 document) and wrote 'алхам алхмын бэлтгэлийн төлөвлөгөө'.
register.prior.*: level labels made bare nouns so 'Та {{level}} төгссөн үү?' reads naturally (Та бакалавр төгссөн үү?); high school = 'бүрэн дунд сургууль' (Mongolian official term) in both places.

'Admitted' rendered as 'элсэлт батлагдлаа / тэнцлээ', not 'та элсэлээ' (which means already enrolled); admission offer = 'элсэлтийн санал'; 'securing your place' = 'суралцах эрхээ баталгаажуулах' (байр would collide with housing).
mobile:login.networkError: dropped the Android-emulator/LAN-IP instructions that are not in the English and would confuse students.
mobile:signup.consent.CROSS_BORDER_VERIFICATION.summary aligned to the English (it listed transfer periods/retention the English does not mention).
Sessions: 'сесс/сешн' replaced with 'нэвтрэлт/төхөөрөмж' wording; 'Sign-in & sessions' -> 'Нэвтрэлт ба төхөөрөмжүүд' (owner may prefer another label).
Null entries (v21.pay.*, v29.mfa.*, v3.agency.waitingOn.*, v4.uni.actor.*, v4.uni.toReview_*) translated fresh.
